integrity: The universal kite dilation formula and minimizer classification follow from complete halving-chord cases and strict monotonicity. Finite numerical tests are corroboration only; no formal proof or external expert attestation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly convex Euclidean kites only, not arbitrary quadrilaterals. The optimizer is defined by a unique nonlinear system. A related 2007 paper and historical dissertation were not available in complete full text; historical priority is best-of-knowledge.
title: Exact Geometric Dilation and Its Unique Minimizer Among Convex Kites
